def compute_model_placement(gpu_num, models):
    """Greedily balance current KVPR, then apply strictly improving feasible moves."""
    placement = {i: [] for i in range(gpu_num)}
    remaining = [GPU_MEM_SIZE] * gpu_num
    pressure = [0.0] * gpu_num

    for model in sorted(models, key=lambda m: m.req_rate / m.slo, reverse=True):
        candidates = [i for i in range(gpu_num)
                      if remaining[i] >= model.model_size]
        if not candidates:
            raise ValueError(
                f"Unable to place model of size {model.model_size} GB; "
                f"remaining memory: {remaining}"
            )
        gpu = min(candidates, key=lambda i: pressure[i] / remaining[i])
        placement[gpu].append(model)
        remaining[gpu] -= model.model_size
        pressure[gpu] += model.req_rate / model.slo

    def ratio(i):
        return pressure[i] / remaining[i] if remaining[i] else float("inf")

    for _ in models:
        old = [ratio(i) for i in range(gpu_num)]
        best, move = max(old), None
        for src in range(gpu_num):
            for model in placement[src]:
                size = model.model_size
                load = model.req_rate / model.slo
                for dst in range(gpu_num):
                    if src == dst or remaining[dst] < size:
                        continue
                    free = remaining[dst] - size
                    target = ((pressure[dst] + load) / free
                              if free else float("inf"))
                    source = ((pressure[src] - load) /
                              (remaining[src] + size))
                    value = max(source if i == src else target if i == dst
                                else old[i] for i in range(gpu_num))
                    if value < best:
                        best, move = value, (src, dst, model, load)

        if move is None:
            break
        src, dst, model, load = move
        placement[src].remove(model)
        placement[dst].append(model)
        remaining[src] += model.model_size
        remaining[dst] -= model.model_size
        pressure[src] -= load
        pressure[dst] += load

    return placement
